newsitem.headline: TABLE - Homestead Village Q2 revs, net up.

text.p: Three Months Ended Six Months Ended

NOTES: (1) On October 17, 1996, Homestead Village acquired all of the extended-stay lodging assets operating or to be operated under the Homestead Village trademark through the merger of various wholly-owned subsidiaries of Security Capital Group Inc, Security Capital Pacific Trust and Security Capital Atlantic Inc, all affiliates of Homestead Village, in exchange for common stock.

The merger with the subsidiaries of Pacific Trust was accounted for as a combination of entities under common control in a manner similar to a pooling of interest; thus the historical financial results of the Trust subsidiaries are presented for all periods before October 17, 1996, and, as Homestead had no activities through June 30, 1996, the financial results consist exclusively of the activities of the Trust subsidiaries for the three and six months ended June 30, 1996.

(2) Comparable properties defined as those 20 properties that were operational from January 1, 1996 through June 30, 1997. Stabilized properties are defined as those 31 properties in 1997 and 22 properties in 1996 which are beyond the initial lease up period of 20 weeks. Additionally there were 11 properties in lease up as of June 30, 1997.
(3) EBITDA is earnings before interest, income taxes, depreciation and amortization.

(4) No historical EPS presented for 1996. The shares and equity interests of the merged entities differed substantially from the shares, warrants and convertible mortgages outstanding after the mergers, therefore, management does not believe that historical EPS data is meaningful. Pro forma EPS assume issuance of the shares and warrants for the acquisition of the Pacific Trust subsidiaries as of the beginning of 1996.
Full co name is Homestead Village Inc.
